text: Power Engineering and Engineering Thermophysics is a comprehensive discipline centered on "laws of energy conversion and transfer", focusing on energy-efficient utilization, optimization of power systems, and related engineering technologies. It is a fundamental and core supporting discipline in the field of energy and power. Based on thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and heat transfer theory, it integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as mechanical engineering, materials science, and control science. It not only studies the clean and efficient utilization of traditional energy sources (such as coal, oil, and natural gas), but also explores the development technologies of new energy sources (such as hydrogen energy, solar energy, and geothermal energy). It plays an irreplaceable role in national economic development, energy security, and the realization of the "dual carbon" goals.
